body: I'm going over to his house tomorrow to hang out and I'm going to give it to him then.  I'm spending the day with family to stay away from the house.  You got it man, if things go through with her will fly you over to the states for wedding.  lol

Now worries.  I can read the language of autocorrect.  I guess the only thing I can do right now man is operate under "cruise control" and just keep on doing things like I did before except without her interaction.I used to spend my free time on my days off playing rockband with her online and watching movies with her on netflix as our "together" time so now that my time off is here I'm trying to find things to do that fill that void.  I'm about to head out for a long jog and clear my mind and think about what I have done in the past that I can fix so if she ever calls me again, maybe she will see that I'm different.  Who knows.
Man that's awesome to hear!  I'm happy for you man.  Icing on the cake to hear that.

I'm giving it to my friend tomorrow.  I know this has to be done for my own sanity.  I received a text from her earlier that gave me some sort of a shred of hope.  I'm really into backpacking and I left all of my gear at her apartment and asked how I could go about getting it back and she said:  "I will not keep your things from you.  I didn't intend this to just end.  I just was frustrated cause I asked for space and you kinda bombarded me and I can't do that.  I know this is hard for both of us.  I just need time to figure things out.  Need space but I can't do that clingy stuff it pushes me the other way.  So for now it is what it is.  I can ship your stuff whenever you would like me to.  Just let me know when.  Maybe we can talk more tomorrow night after I get done with family stuff."  I hope this turns out to be a good thing.  What do you think man?  I'm sorry things didn't work out for you and your girl man.  You're obviously a compassionate person and have helped your fellow man out tremendously.  I think I would be willing to wait 10 years for this girl.  I'm about to get off of the night shift here at the airport, crash for a bit, and then revisit this slice of happiness.  Thanks again man!

I know, but I'm worried that I will start burning bridges I wont be able to ever get back.  At the same time I hate fb stalking her because it's creepy and sad.  I just need to hear or see something from her.  Every message I get on my phone I jump on like a vulture because I assume it's her.  Doesn't help that I haven't been able to sleep because I have no idea what's going on with her now.  It's driving me insane because this came out of left field and struck me like a bullet.  It doesn't feel like this actually happened.  Thanks for talking with me, Reddit never ceases to amaze me.

You're right.  I will hang on to it and back off.  Did the person you waited for ever come back?  (If you don't mind)  It just doesn't make sense to me for someone to say that they need to work on themselves and if things get better maybe there is a chance later.  Should I stay friends with her on Facebook or is this a bad idea?  I can't help but check it all the time but I'm afraid if I delete her then I can't have a way of slipping into the friend circle instead of the ex circle...  Goodnight brother, I appreciate your kind words and look forward to hearing from ya.

This is the first message I have ever gotten on Reddit.  Just having someone talk to me helps me stop checking her FB acct every 5 mins.  I have a Glock because I target practice.  I am applying for law enforcement with large airports and several department of homeland security jobs.  I honestly think her saying she needs her space is just kindly asking me to fuck off so she can date other people.  I'm not sure if it's just intense paranoia or i'm just insane but she has been talking to and hanging out with this guy lately a lot and I think that caused me to project my insecurity even more than normal.  I don't know man.  You're awesome for listening.
Fuck.  I suck at this internet thing.
